# IFC security fixtures

Fixtures are intentionally non-production inputs for security/E2E validation.
They must never be imported into a production project.

- `traversal-name.ifc`: valid tiny STEP payload used with an unsafe multipart filename such as `../model.ifc`.
- `invalid-step.ifc`: syntactically invalid payload that must be rejected before semantic import.
- Oversized input is generated by the test script; no huge binary fixture is committed.
